data.command: select case when PartneriId = @PartneriId then 1 else 0 end as Ind_Provjera from parstru where parstruid = @ParstruId
data.name: dtProvjeriPartnera

data.command: select cast(year(datumdok) as varchar(4)) + right('00' + cast(month(datumdok) as varchar(2)), 2) as Tree_node from ProNotpGla where ProNotpGlaId = @ProNotpGlaId
data.name: dtDajNode

data.command: select coalesce(@par1, '') + char(13) + char(10) + coalesce(@par2, '') as tekst
data.name: dtNapomena

data.command: select count(*) as Broj from DimVrste
data.name: dtDimVrste
